claim: One eye_paper_enrich call over the arXiv id and the journal DOI of the SAME ATLAS Higgs-discovery paper surfaces two provenance-distinct citation counts that differ by ~5x, and links the two records via integrity.journal_doi.

upstream_of_record.field: message.is-referenced-by-count for 10.1016/j.physletb.2012.08.020, against s2 citationCount for arXiv:1207.7214 (and openalex cited_by_count for the same DOI)

ground_truth.expected_now: arXiv leg (kind=arxiv, Semantic Scholar): 1327; DOI leg (kind=doi, Crossref): 6801 -> 5.1x. Third value from eye_search(sources=['openalex']): cited_by_count=10861 with computed_by='source:openalex/cited_by' -> 8.2x total spread

notes: The fact under test is that the disagreement is EXPOSED with provenance, not which number is right; the split is structural (S2 keeps separate preprint and published records). The 1327 value reproduced on two separate runs. Stability caveat, measured: the S2 leg 429s for anonymous callers (I reproduced this on api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/arXiv:1207.7214), so that leg can transiently return null and the judge should retry or use a key; the Crossref and OpenAlex legs are keyless and stable. Third value re-fetchable at https://api.openalex.org/works/doi:10.1016/j.physletb.2012.08.020.
